question: Top 3 cities by average order value
reference_sql:
SELECT c.city,
                  AVG(order_totals.total) AS avg_order_value
           FROM customers c
           JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
           JOIN (
               SELECT order_id,
                      SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total
               FROM order_items
               GROUP BY order_id
           ) order_totals ON order_totals.order_id = o.order_id
           WHERE o.status = 'completed'
           GROUP BY c.city
           ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 3

question: Top 10 product categories by revenue
reference_sql:
SELECT p.category,
                  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
           FROM products p
           JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
           JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
           WHERE o.status = 'completed'
           GROUP BY p.category
           ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
